plainLanguage: Baada ya conviction, court inaweza kuamuru offender amlipe compensation mtu aliyejeruhiwa na offence yake. Section 31 haisimami peke yake: power hiyo inatumika kwa mujibu wa section 348 ya Criminal Procedure Act.
meaning: Compensation inaweza kuwa in addition to punishment nyingine au in substitution for punishment nyingine. Lakini entitlement, assessment na procedure hazipaswi kubuniwa kutoka Penal Code pekee; section 31 expressly imports the Criminal Procedure Act framework.
keyPoints: Recipient ni person injured by the offence.
Compensation may supplement or substitute another punishment.
Power is expressly governed by CPA section 348.
Amount and procedure require the applicable CPA framework and evidence of injury/loss.

legalTerms.meaning: Court-ordered payment to a person injured by the offence, under the statutory framework.
Kutumika badala ya punishment nyingine pale sheria na court determination vinaporuhusu.

examples.title: Property loss
examples.scenario: Victim amepata proven loss kutokana na offence na accused ametiwa hatiani.
examples.analysis: Section 31 opens compensation route, but court must apply CPA section 348 and evidence rather than assume an amount.

history.summary: Section 31 deliberately links Penal Code sentencing to the Criminal Procedure Act compensation mechanism.
notes: Cross-reference to CPA section 348 is part of the official text.
Live sentencing should verify the current CPA provision before calculating or advising on compensation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Compensation analysis should be evidence-led: identify the person injured and the loss/injury causally connected to the offence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Because compensation can supplement or substitute another punishment, the court must situate it within the complete lawful sentence.

debateQuestion: Ni injury/loss gani imethibitishwa kuwa imesababishwa na offence, na CPA section 348 inaruhusu compensation ipangwe vipi?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
